categoryName: Books — school textbooks, reference, competitive exam, general reading, religious literature

skuLines.line: NCERT textbooks, classes 1-5 (subject-wise)
skuLines.examples: NCERT Mridang / Santoor English, Ganita Prakash Maths, Aas-Paas EVS, Sarangi Hindi
skuLines.packSizes: single title; also class-wise set of 4-6
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr session start (Akal Academy session begins April); July top-up for late admissions
skuLines.notes: Only from an NCERT-appointed state wholesale agent; MRP is printed and fixed, so no pricing freedom. Order Jan-Feb — the Mar-Apr window is one shot and hill freight adds 5-10 days. Printed books are nil-rated GST.

skuLines.line: NCERT textbooks, classes 6-8 (subject-wise)
skuLines.examples: NCERT Ganita Prakash 6-8, Curiosity Science, Exploring Society, Poorvi English
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr peak, July top-up
skuLines.notes: NCF-2023 rollout is mid-stream — titles for 6-8 changed in 2024-26, so old editions become dead stock fast. Never carry more than one session's cover.

skuLines.line: NCERT textbooks, classes 9-10 (subject-wise)
skuLines.examples: NCERT Mathematics, Science, India and the Contemporary World, Beehive/Moments
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr peak; pre-board top-up Nov-Dec
skuLines.notes: NCERT announced a ~20% price cut on classes 9-12 titles effective 2026-27 — reprice and do not over-buy old-price stock ahead of the cut.

skuLines.line: NCERT textbooks, classes 11-12, stream-wise (PCM / PCB / Commerce / Humanities)
skuLines.examples: NCERT Physics Part I-II, Chemistry Part I-II, Biology, Accountancy, Macroeconomics
skuLines.packSizes: part-wise volumes; stream set of 10-14 volumes
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr; second spike Jun-Jul after class-10 results decide streams
skuLines.notes: Stream mix must be forecast from the previous year's class-10 cohort; PCB and PCM sell hardest at a school feeding NEET/JEE.

skuLines.line: Class-wise prescribed booklist SET packs (pre-bundled, hostel-delivered)
skuLines.examples: 'Class VI Akal Academy set', 'Class XI PCB set' — shrink-wrapped NCERT + private publishers + workbooks
skuLines.packSizes: 1 sealed set per student per class/stream
skuLines.priceBand: ₹900-₹4,500 per set depending on class and stream
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr, one intense 3-4 week window
skuLines.notes: The single highest-value line for a captive campus store: one indent against the school's own booklist kills stockouts and off-campus leakage. Needs the school's final booklist by January and a pre-paid/roll-number issue register.

skuLines.line: Private-publisher primary coursebooks (English reader, Maths, EVS, GK)
skuLines.examples: Ratna Sagar Together with English, Oxford New Enjoying Mathematics, Cordova Smart, Madhubun
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr
skuLines.notes: Only stock ISBNs on the school's printed list — publisher-specific and non-returnable once the session starts. IB PYP sections use different titles from CBSE sections.

skuLines.line: Pre-primary writing practice, tracing and cursive books
skuLines.examples: Dreamland Cursive Writing, Wonder House Trace & Write, Navneet Varnmala Lekhan, Kips Pattern Writing
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Jun; steady all year from staff families with 3-6 year olds
skuLines.notes: Highest-margin book line in the store and buys young. Also sells to married staff quarters, not just to the school.

skuLines.line: Hindi and Sanskrit coursebooks + Vyakaran (grammar)
skuLines.examples: Madhuban Hindi Vyakaran, Saraswati Naveen Hindi Vyakaran, Goyal Sanskrit Manika companion
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr
skuLines.notes: Grammar titles change edition less often than readers, so a small carry-over buffer is safe.

skuLines.line: Punjabi coursebooks and Gurmukhi Qaida / Painti Akhri primers
skuLines.examples: Punjabi Painti Akhri board book, Gurmukhi Primer for Beginners (Singh Brothers), Let Us Learn Gurmukhi Bk I-IV, SGPC Gurmukhi primer
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr for the school; year-round for staff families and new non-Punjabi staff
skuLines.notes: Structurally under-served by mainstream distributors; source direct from Amritsar (Singh Brothers, B. Chattar Singh Jiwan Singh) or SGPC. Non-Punjabi staff families are a real, silent buyer of the adult-beginner primer.

skuLines.line: English grammar, composition and spoken-English self-study
skuLines.examples: Wren & Martin High School English Grammar, New Oxford Modern English, Rapidex English Speaking Course (Hindi/Punjabi)
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; Mar-Apr and Jul-Aug peaks
skuLines.notes: Wren & Martin plus its separate key are perennial; Rapidex sells to non-teaching staff and hostel workers, a cohort nobody stocks for.

skuLines.line: School computer science / IT coursebooks
skuLines.examples: Kips Cyber Beans, Sultan Chand Together with IT, Dhanpat Rai Computer Science with Python (Sumita Arora)
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr
skuLines.notes: Sumita Arora Python (XI/XII) doubles as a university first-year reference for the B.Tech CSE cohort — one title, two buyers.

skuLines.line: Moral science / value education / Gurmat Sikhya school books
skuLines.examples: SGPC Gurmat Sikhya series, Sikh Missionary Society readers, publisher value-education graded readers
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr; refresher demand at Gurpurab season
skuLines.notes: Institution-specific: a Kalgidhar Trust campus prescribes these where other CBSE schools would not. Likely bought by the school in bulk as well as by parents.

skuLines.line: School atlas and wall maps
skuLines.examples: Oxford Student Atlas for India, Orient BlackSwan School Atlas, India/World political laminated wall maps
skuLines.packSizes: single atlas; folded or laminated map sheet
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr; again Sep-Nov for UPSC/SSC aspirants
skuLines.notes: Oxford Student Atlas is simultaneously a school requirement and a UPSC/SSC staple — carry it deep. Store flat; laminated maps curl in monsoon damp.

skuLines.line: Dictionaries — English-English, English-Hindi, English-Punjabi, Punjabi-Punjabi
skuLines.examples: Oxford Advanced Learner's, Rajpal English-Hindi, Chambers school dictionary, Punjabi-English (Singh Brothers), Mahan Kosh (reference copy)
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr and Jul-Aug
skuLines.notes: Keep one display copy of the big reference titles and sell the pocket/school editions in volume. English-Punjabi and Punjabi-English are the ones a Delhi distributor will forget to send.

skuLines.line: General knowledge annuals and current-affairs yearbooks
skuLines.examples: Manorama Yearbook, Lucent's General Knowledge, BPI/Arihant GK graded series, Bharat/India Yearbook
skuLines.seasonality: New edition Dec-Feb; sells Jan-Jul
skuLines.notes: Dated stock: last year's yearbook is unsellable. Buy narrow, reorder rather than pile up.

skuLines.line: Lab manuals, practical record books and project files (school + college)
skuLines.examples: Together With Lab Manual Physics/Chemistry/Biology XI-XII, Comprehensive Practical Chemistry, blank practical record journals
skuLines.seasonality: Jul-Aug and Nov-Jan (practical exams / viva)
skuLines.notes: Very spiky and very cheap to miss: a stockout the week before practicals sends the whole hostel to town. Nursing and agriculture cohorts need journals too.

skuLines.line: Kirtan, Gurmat Sangeet and instrument tutor books
skuLines.examples: Gurmat Sangeet raag primers, tabla/harmonium/vaja tutors (Gurmukhi), Shabad kirtan pothis with notation
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; spikes with kirtan competitions and Gurpurabs
skuLines.notes: Distinctive to this campus — Akal Academy runs kirtan training. Nobody in modern trade carries these; source from Amritsar/Ludhiana publishers.

skuLines.line: CBSE question banks and all-in-one guides, classes 9-12
skuLines.examples: Oswaal Question Bank, Educart Question Bank, Xam Idea (VK Global), Arihant All In One, Full Marks Guide
skuLines.packSizes: per subject per class; 4-5 book combos
skuLines.seasonality: Aug-Dec build-up, hardest Nov-Jan pre-boards
skuLines.marginBand: 25-40% list (realised 15-25% after the discounting students expect)
skuLines.notes: Online MRP discounting is the competitive threat — but a campus 30-50 km from a market has a genuine convenience premium. Editions are dated (…for 2027 Board Exams); anything unsold by March is dead.

skuLines.line: CBSE sample question papers, previous-year papers and NCERT Exemplar
skuLines.examples: Oswaal 15 Sample Question Papers Cl 10/12, Educart Sample Papers, Xamidea Sample Papers, NCERT Exemplar Problems
skuLines.seasonality: Dec-Feb, extremely sharp; CBSE releases the SQP pattern around Sep so titles land Oct-Nov
skuLines.notes: The most perishable book in the shop — a 3-month sell window, worthless in April. Air-tight forecast off board-appearing student counts.

skuLines.line: School reference series, Maths and Science (classes 6-10)
skuLines.examples: RD Sharma Mathematics, RS Aggarwal Mathematics, Lakhmir Singh & Manjit Kaur Physics/Chemistry/Biology, Together With Science
skuLines.packSizes: single title per class per subject
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr and Aug-Nov
skuLines.notes: Slow-changing titles — safest carry-over stock in the whole books department.

skuLines.line: Senior-secondary subject standards (XI-XII)
skuLines.examples: HC Verma Concepts of Physics, DC Pandey Physics, MS Chouhan Organic Chemistry, Trueman's Biology, TS Grewal Accountancy, Sandeep Garg Economics
skuLines.seasonality: Apr-Aug (fresh XI intake) and year-round for XII
skuLines.notes: TS Grewal and Sandeep Garg carry over into B.Com/BBA at Eternal University — same title, two cohorts, so depth is justified.

skuLines.line: Teacher resource books, answer keys and curriculum documents
skuLines.examples: Publisher teacher's manuals, solution keys, CBSE curriculum & syllabus documents, NCERT teacher's handbooks, CTET-linked pedagogy titles
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Jun (session planning)
skuLines.notes: Institutional line — the school and university buy these on indent, often against a purchase order rather than at the counter. Publishers frequently supply teacher copies free with adoption; check before charging.

skuLines.line: IB PYP and Cambridge (Checkpoint/IGCSE) coursebooks and workbooks
skuLines.examples: Oxford IB PYP inquiry resources, Cambridge Primary/Checkpoint Maths & Science, Hodder Cambridge, Collins International
skuLines.priceBand: ₹700-₹3,500 per book (Indian editions cheaper than imports)
skuLines.seasonality: Mar-Apr, long lead time
skuLines.notes: Special-order line, 3-6 week lead, part imported. Akal Academy runs IB PYP and Cambridge alongside CBSE, so these are real but low-volume — take advance orders with deposit, never speculate on stock.

skuLines.line: NEET / medical entrance preparation
skuLines.examples: MTG NCERT at Your Fingertips Biology/Physics/Chemistry, MTG 34-Years NEET PYQ Chapterwise, Trueman's Elementary Biology, Allen/Aakash module sets
skuLines.seasonality: Apr-Jun (fresh XI/repeaters) and Sep-Dec (pre-exam grind); NEET is early May
skuLines.notes: A CBSE residential school with a nursing/health college on campus makes NEET the anchor exam line. Also bought by drop-year repeaters who stay on campus.

skuLines.line: JEE / engineering entrance preparation
skuLines.examples: Cengage Maths for JEE, Arihant 44 Years JEE PYQ, DC Pandey Understanding Physics, MS Chouhan Organic, HC Verma
skuLines.seasonality: Apr-Jun and Oct-Jan (JEE Main Jan & Apr sessions)
skuLines.notes: Smaller cohort than NEET at a Sikh institution with an on-campus health-sciences college; keep it shallow but present.

skuLines.line: CUET UG / university entrance guides
skuLines.examples: Arihant CUET UG domain guides, Oswaal CUET Question Bank, Arihant CUET General Test
skuLines.packSizes: per domain subject; general test volume
skuLines.seasonality: Dec-Apr (CUET is May)
skuLines.notes: Rising fast as central-university admission consolidates on CUET; the humanities/commerce students who don't sit NEET/JEE sit this.

skuLines.line: Defence and uniformed-services recruitment guides
skuLines.examples: Arihant NDA/NA Pathfinder, Agniveer Army/Air Force/Navy guides, RS Aggarwal reasoning, HP Police & Patwari guides
skuLines.seasonality: NDA notification Dec & Jun; Agniveer rallies announced through the year
skuLines.notes: Hill-state demographic reality — defence recruitment is a mainstream aspiration in Himachal, and mainland-metro merchandising misses it entirely.

skuLines.line: Himachal Pradesh state-exam GK and guides
skuLines.examples: Arihant Know Your State Himachal Pradesh, Upkar HP GK At a Glance, CivilsTap HP GK, HG Publications Objective GK HP, HP TET guides
skuLines.seasonality: Follows HPPSC/HPRCA/HP TET notifications; year-round base
skuLines.notes: Local-monopoly line: an HP resident buying HP GK has literally no alternative within 30-50 km. Cheap, high-turn, and a reason to walk in.

skuLines.line: UPSC / State PSC foundation standards
skuLines.examples: Laxmikanth Indian Polity, Spectrum Modern India, Lucent's GK, Shankar IAS Environment, NCERT-based UPSC sets
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; May-Jun (prelims) and post-result Jul
skuLines.notes: Editions revise annually; stock the four or five titles every aspirant buys rather than a wide civil-services wall.

skuLines.line: SSC / Banking / Railway aptitude and previous-year papers
skuLines.examples: RS Aggarwal Quantitative Aptitude, SP Bakshi Objective General English, Kiran SSC PYQ chapterwise, Paramount/Adda247 practice sets
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; spikes on SSC CGL/CHSL and IBPS notifications
skuLines.notes: RS Aggarwal Quantitative Aptitude is the single best-selling exam book in India — never be out of it.

skuLines.line: CTET / HP TET / B.Ed entrance guides
skuLines.examples: Arihant CTET Paper I & II, Disha CTET PYQ, Arihant HP TET (Arts/Medical/Non-Medical), B.Ed entrance guides
skuLines.seasonality: CTET Jan & Jul cycles; HP TET on notification
skuLines.notes: Doubly relevant here: Eternal University runs education programmes and the campus employs a large teaching staff who need TET/CTET for progression.

skuLines.line: Nursing entrance and staff-nurse / NORCET exam books
skuLines.examples: NORCET AIIMS guides (Jaypee/CBS), staff nurse recruitment PYQ, Sarvgyan/Arihant BSc Nursing entrance guides
skuLines.seasonality: Entrance guides Mar-Jun; NORCET/state staff-nurse on notification, year-round base
skuLines.notes: Directly tied to Akal College of Health & Allied Sciences (B.Sc/M.Sc Nursing) — the exit exam for every nursing graduate on campus. Specialist distributor, not a general one.

skuLines.line: ICAR AIEEA / JRF / NET agriculture exam books
skuLines.examples: Jain Brothers General Agriculture (Muniraj Singh Rathore), Kalyani ICAR UG guides, ICAR AIEEA-UG guide (R Gupta), Agriaddict/AgriMly subject books
skuLines.seasonality: AIEEA-UG Mar-Jun; JRF/SRF/NET Jun-Sep
skuLines.notes: Eternal University runs B.Sc(Hons) Agriculture and M.Sc — the Jain Brothers 'General Agriculture' is the near-universal title. Source from Jain Brothers / Kalyani direct; mainstream distributors don't hold it.

skuLines.line: Study-abroad and language tests (IELTS / TOEFL / GRE / GATE)
skuLines.examples: Cambridge IELTS 19/20 practice tests, Official IELTS Guide, Barron's/Manhattan GRE, GATE previous papers (GK Publications)
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; Sep-Dec and Mar-May application cycles
skuLines.notes: Small but high-ticket. Nursing graduates going abroad are the main IELTS buyer; keep 2-3 titles and take orders for the rest.

skuLines.line: B.Sc / M.Sc Nursing textbooks (INC syllabus)
skuLines.examples: Jogindra Vati Nursing Foundation (Jaypee), DeWit's Fundamental Concepts (Elsevier, Indian adaptation), Quick Review Series for B.Sc Nursing, CBS/Neelkanth subject texts
skuLines.seasonality: Jul-Aug session start; Jan even-semester top-up
skuLines.notes: Heavy, expensive, non-returnable — buy against a departmental booklist, not on speculation. INC revised the syllabus, so edition-matching matters: a superseded edition is unsellable.

skuLines.line: B.Sc (Hons) Agriculture / ICAR UG course textbooks
skuLines.examples: Kalyani Publishers agronomy/horticulture/soil science texts, Jain Brothers subject texts, New Vishal, ICAR e-course companions
skuLines.seasonality: Jul-Aug and Jan
skuLines.notes: Kalyani is the default Indian agriculture publisher; order semester-wise against the college's course list.

skuLines.line: B.Tech textbooks — Computer Science and Food Technology
skuLines.examples: Technical Publications (semester-wise), Sumita Arora/Reema Thareja Python & DBMS, Khanna Publishers, Wiley India, Food Science & Technology texts (New Age/CBS)
skuLines.seasonality: Jul-Aug and Jan
skuLines.notes: Eternal University's two live B.Tech streams are CSE and Food Technology — don't carry a general engineering wall, carry those two syllabi.

skuLines.line: B.Sc / B.Com / BBA / BA general-degree textbooks and guides
skuLines.examples: S Chand & Kalyani degree texts, Taxmann commerce law, TS Grewal/Sandeep Garg (carry-over), state-university help guides
skuLines.seasonality: Jul-Aug and Jan
skuLines.notes: Guides sell better than prescribed texts in general-degree streams. Confirm the exact university edition — a Punjab-university guide won't match the syllabus.

skuLines.line: B.Ed / M.Ed and education-pedagogy textbooks
skuLines.examples: Vinod/Agarwal B.Ed texts, R Lal & Sons education series, Learning & Teaching pedagogy titles
skuLines.seasonality: Jul-Aug; Jan
skuLines.notes: Overlaps CTET/HP TET stock — one shelf can serve both aspirants and B.Ed students.

skuLines.line: Gutka Sahib / Nitnem — pocket, Gurmukhi
skuLines.examples: SGPC Nitnem gutka, Singh Brothers Nitnem, B. Chattar Singh Jiwan Singh Nitnem, bold-print pocket gutka
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; spikes at Gurpurabs (Guru Nanak Nov, Guru Gobind Singh Dec/Jan, Vaisakhi Apr) and at Amrit Sanchar camps
skuLines.marginBand: 10-25% (SGPC titles are subsidised, often sold near cost)
skuLines.notes: Handle as saroop-adjacent religious material: clean, covered, elevated shelf, never on the floor or under other goods — a display mistake here is a community offence, not a merchandising one. Highest-frequency book line on a Sikh campus.

skuLines.line: Sundar Gutka / Sampooran Gutka — large print, cloth-covered, with rumala
skuLines.examples: SGPC Sundar Gutka, Sampooran Gutka with extended banis, cloth/velvet-covered gutka with rumala sahib, zip cases
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; Gurpurab and gift/vidai season peaks
skuLines.notes: Large print is specifically the elderly cohort's line — do not substitute pocket editions for them. Sells as a gift item at graduations, weddings and Amrit ceremonies.

skuLines.line: Sehaj Path pothi sets, SGGS teeka / Darpan and Sanchian
skuLines.examples: Sri Guru Granth Sahib Darpan (Prof Sahib Singh, 10 vols), SGPC Sehaj Path pothi set, Faridkot teeka, Sanchian sets
skuLines.seasonality: Gurpurabs; family Path/Akhand Path occasions
skuLines.notes: Reverence protocol is mandatory — dedicated covered almirah, rumala, no stacking with commercial goods, and issue with a clean cloth wrap. Better handled as indent-on-request than open display. Absolute must-not-get-wrong for a Kalgidhar Trust campus.

skuLines.line: Gurbani with translation and Roman transliteration
skuLines.examples: Nitnem with Punjabi & English translation (Dr Kulwant Singh), Sukhmani Sahib with English meaning, Japji Sahib Steek, Roman-script gutka
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: The line for the young and for non-Punjabi-reading staff and their children — a large and growing share on a national-intake residential campus.

skuLines.line: Sikh history and Guru biographies
skuLines.examples: SGPC history titles, Singh Brothers Sikh history list, Dr Harjinder Singh Dilgeer, Prof Sahib Singh, Max Arthur Macauliffe (reprint)
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; Nov and Dec (Shaheedi Diwas of the Sahibzade) peaks
skuLines.notes: Also an institutional buy: school library, prize distribution, and visiting-guest gifting.

skuLines.line: Sikh children's story books and comics
skuLines.examples: Sikh Comics (Daljeet Singh Sidhu) Sahibzade/Guru series, Singh Brothers children's Sikh stories, illustrated Sakhian, bilingual Sikh picture books
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; Gurpurab and prize-distribution season
skuLines.notes: The best-fit, most under-supplied line for this specific campus: illustrated Sikh content for 5-12 year olds. Modern trade carries zero of it; a school of residential children is the ideal buyer, and the school itself buys these as annual-day prizes.

skuLines.line: Sikh Rehat Maryada, Ardas and Amrit-guidance booklets
skuLines.examples: SGPC Sikh Rehat Maryada booklet, Ardas booklet, Amritdhari guidance pamphlets, Gurmat parchar tracts
skuLines.packSizes: 12-64 page booklet; bundles of 10/25 for distribution
skuLines.seasonality: Amrit Sanchar camps, Vaisakhi, new-student intake
skuLines.marginBand: 5-20% (often distributed at or below cost by the trust)
skuLines.notes: Frequently a sponsored/free-distribution item rather than a margin line — treat volume and availability as the KPI, not gross profit. Bundle packs matter for camps.

skuLines.line: Punjabi literature, poetry and novels
skuLines.examples: Bhai Vir Singh, Nanak Singh, Amrita Pritam, Shiv Kumar Batalvi, Singh Brothers / Sangam / Lokgeet Punjabi list
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; winter reading season and Punjabi-week/literary events
skuLines.notes: Genuine adult leisure-reading demand on a Punjabi-medium-adjacent campus, and completely absent from any national e-commerce assortment shipped to PIN 173101 quickly.

skuLines.line: Nanakshahi Jantri, religious calendars and diaries
skuLines.examples: SGPC Nanakshahi Jantri, Gurpurab wall calendars, Sikh dated diary/planner, Hindu panchang/jantri (for other-faith staff)
skuLines.packSizes: single jantri; wall calendar; A5/B5 diary
skuLines.seasonality: Nov-Jan, extremely concentrated; dead by February
skuLines.notes: Hard-dated stock — buy for a 10-week window and clear it. Wall calendars are bulky, low-value and monsoon-vulnerable; ship in Nov, not later.

skuLines.line: Children's board books, picture books and bedtime story collections (0-6)
skuLines.examples: Dreamland board books, Wonder House first-words, Om Books 365 Stories, Scholastic early readers
skuLines.packSizes: single board book; boxed 4-10 book sets
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; gifting spikes at birthdays, Children's Day, winter break
skuLines.notes: Serves the married-staff-quarters cohort with babies and toddlers, who have no other shop within 30-50 km. Best margin in the whole books department. Board books survive hill damp better than paperbacks.

skuLines.line: Comics and story digests — Indian classics
skuLines.examples: Amar Chitra Katha single titles & 5-in-1 packs, Tinkle Digest, Panchatantra, Akbar-Birbal, Tenali Rama, Suppandi collections
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; strong in vacations and exam-free weeks
skuLines.notes: Highest-repeat impulse book for 8-14 year olds and ideal for the small Ary Lite counter. ACK also runs Audible audiobook editions from 2026 — a screen-free alternative in a hostel with device limits.

skuLines.line: Children's magazines (subscription and single copy)
skuLines.examples: Champak (Hindi/English), Nandan, Tinkle, Highlights Champs, Chandamama reprints
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Periodicals need a disciplined arrival-and-return rhythm; hill transit delay of 3-5 days makes single-copy sale unreliable, so push annual subscriptions and school-library sets instead.

skuLines.line: Activity, colouring, sticker and puzzle books
skuLines.examples: Dreamland colouring/activity books, Wonder House sticker books, sudoku & word-search for kids, GK quiz activity books
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; heavy in vacations and rainy days
skuLines.notes: Monsoon indoor-activity line and a strong hostel-warden bulk buy. Cheap, high-turn, forgiving of damp because it's consumed fast.

skuLines.line: Young-adult and school-library fiction
skuLines.examples: Ruskin Bond (Rusty/hill stories), Diary of a Wimpy Kid, Geronimo Stilton, Harry Potter, Percy Jackson, Enid Blyton, Sudha Murty for children
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; strongest in Dec-Jan winter break and summer break
skuLines.notes: A 5,000-person residential campus with device limits is unusually strong for physical leisure reading. Ruskin Bond specifically — his settings are these hills. Also the natural school-library and prize-distribution buy.

skuLines.line: Adult general fiction — Indian mass-market and current global bestsellers
skuLines.examples: Chetan Bhagat, Amish Tripathi, Ravinder Singh, Sudha Murty; BookTok/romantasy (Fourth Wing, ACOTAR), Colleen Hoover
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; winter reading peak
skuLines.notes: India's fiction revenue grew ~30% in 2024 and romantasy/BookTok titles are 66% bought by 13-34 year olds — squarely the Eternal University cohort. Keep it small, current, and face-out; a stale bestseller wall is capital sitting on a shelf.

skuLines.line: Self-help, motivation and personal finance
skuLines.examples: Ikigai, Atomic Habits, The Psychology of Money, Rich Dad Poor Dad, Hindi/Punjabi translations of the same
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; Jan (new-year) spike
skuLines.notes: The Hindi and Punjabi translated editions outsell English for non-teaching staff — stock the language edition the buyer actually reads, not just the English one.

skuLines.line: Pregnancy, baby-care and parenting books
skuLines.examples: What to Expect When You're Expecting (Indian ed.), Dr Spock/Indian paediatric baby-care guides, Hindi/Punjabi garbhavastha & shishu-paalan titles
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Directly aimed at the married-staff-with-small-children cohort; regional-language editions matter more than English here. Very low competition — nobody stocks this in a hill township.

skuLines.line: Health, yoga, Ayurveda, home-remedy and cookery books
skuLines.examples: Ayurveda gharelu nuskhe (Hindi/Punjabi), yoga & pranayama guides, diabetes/BP diet books, Punjabi & Indian vegetarian cookery, Nita Mehta
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; winter (joint/cold remedies) and Jan health-resolution spike
skuLines.notes: Elderly and staff-family staple, sold overwhelmingly in Hindi and Punjabi. Vegetarian/no-alcohol content only, consistent with the institution.

skuLines.line: Newspapers and general-interest magazines
skuLines.examples: Ajit & Jagbani (Punjabi), Amar Ujala/Dainik Bhaskar, The Tribune, India Today, Reader's Digest, Competition Success Review, Pratiyogita Darpan
skuLines.packSizes: daily copy; monthly issue; annual subscription
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; exam magazines peak with notifications
skuLines.notes: Hill delivery arrives late and is monsoon-disrupted; run a subscriber register rather than counter piles. Pratiyogita Darpan and CSR are the cheap monthly current-affairs habit for every aspirant on campus and pull footfall.

skuLines.line: Other-faith devotional shelf (small)
skuLines.examples: Gita Press Gorakhpur Bhagavad Gita, Hanuman Chalisa, Sundarkand, Ramayana; Bible; small Quran shelf
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; festival spikes (Navratri, Diwali, Ram Navami)
skuLines.notes: Non-Sikh staff and their families live on campus too and have nowhere else to buy this. Keep it a genuinely small, respectful, clearly separate shelf — presence matters more than depth, and every faith's books need the same clean handling as the Sikh shelf.

skuLines.line: Pocket-price impulse titles (₹20-₹60)
skuLines.examples: Pocket Sukhmani Sahib / Japji Sahib booklet, mini story books, Chanakya Neeti, joke & riddle books, pocket GK
skuLines.packSizes: single 16-48 page booklet; counter display of 20-40
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round
skuLines.notes: Built for the Ary Lite counter and the POS queue: pocket-money price point, no decision cost, and it is the shape in which a hostel child buys a book with their own money.

trends2026: NCERT confirmed a ~20% price cut on classes 9-12 textbooks from the 2026-27 session (classes 1-8 held at ~₹65) — retail rupee value per class set falls while unit volume holds, so a books P&L built on last year's ASP will read as a sales decline that isn't one

NCF-2023 / NEP textbook churn is still mid-rollout: renamed NCERT titles (Ganita Prakash, Mridang, Curiosity, Poorvi) keep replacing older ones class by class, which makes carry-over textbook stock the single biggest write-off risk in this category right now

CBSE's move to two board attempts for class 10 and heavier competency/case-based questioning has pushed demand from plain textbooks toward question banks, sample-paper sets and PYQ compilations (Oswaal, Educart, Xam Idea) — a second, later, Dec-Feb selling season on top of the Mar-Apr one

Indian book market ~USD 5.1 bn in 2025 heading to ~USD 7.3 bn by 2034 (~4% CAGR), with print still 72.6% of format share — physical books are not being displaced in India, but e-books (16.3%) and audiobooks (11.1%) are growing 9-12% and Amar Chitra Katha itself began Audible editions in 2025-26 with Indian-language releases in 2026

Fiction is the fastest-moving trade segment (India posted ~+30.7% fiction revenue growth in 2024) driven by BookTok and romantasy, with ~66% of those titles bought by 13-34 year olds — exactly the school-senior and university cohort living on this campus

Q-commerce has entered books and stationery: Blinkit runs a children's-books category and Zepto a notebooks/stationery category with 10-30 minute delivery — irrelevant to PIN 173101 as competition, but it is resetting what younger buyers consider a normal wait, and it is where they browse before they buy

Regional-language publishing is the growth story behind the English headline — Punjabi/Hindi editions of self-help, parenting and health titles now sell where only English used to be stocked, and Gurmukhi-script children's and learning material has moved from niche to expected

Aggressive online MRP discounting (Amazon/Flipkart/publisher D2C stores like arihantbooks.com, store.pw.live, oswaalbooks.com) has compressed realised margin on branded exam books nationally — a captive, road-isolated location is one of the few places the full-MRP model still holds, and that advantage should be priced deliberately rather than accidentally

Basic student paper goods moved to nil GST in the Sept-2025 rate rationalisation alongside printed books (which were already exempt) — worth re-confirming against the current notification before pricing, but if it holds, the whole books-and-exercise-book shelf is an output-tax-free, ITC-less line that should be accounted separately from taxable categories
adjacentServices: Booklist indent service with the school and university: take the printed class-wise/semester-wise booklist in January, pre-pack sealed sets against roll numbers, and issue at the hostel — converts the Mar-Apr rush from a stockout risk into a pre-sold order book

Special order / indent counter with a posted lead time (7-21 days) for IB PYP, Cambridge, nursing, agriculture and any title not worth stocking — a deposit-backed order list is how a single-outlet store legitimately carries 'everything' without carrying the inventory

Textbook buy-back and second-hand exchange at session end: a residential campus is a closed loop, so last year's class-XI set can be resold to this year's class XI — margin on a book that cost nothing, and it stops the parallel WhatsApp resale market

Institutional and library supply against purchase order: school library, university library, departmental sets, teacher reference copies, and the annual-day / prize-distribution book buy (schools purchase books as prizes in volume, usually in one order)
Book covering, brown-paper wrapping, name-labelling and lamination at session start — a paid 10-minute service every hostel child needs in the same fortnight
Photocopy, printing, spiral and hard binding for project files, practical records, dissertations and thesis submission — the university cohort's recurring, deadline-driven need

Subscription desk for newspapers, children's magazines (Champak/Nandan/Tinkle) and current-affairs monthlies (Pratiyogita Darpan, CSR), billed monthly to quarters and hostels — turns unreliable hill delivery into a guaranteed-copy service
Exam-season pop-up counter (Nov-Feb) for sample papers, PYQ sets and stationery, sited near the school block rather than the main store

Small paid lending library / reading corner (₹50-100 per month) for leisure fiction, comics and Punjabi literature — one copy earns many times over in a closed community of 5,000 and de-risks the slow-moving trade titles

Gurmat parchar literature distribution point: bundled Rehat Maryada, Ardas and Sikh-history booklets supplied at or near cost for Amrit Sanchar camps, new-student intake and Gurpurab programmes, typically trust-sponsored rather than margin-earning
Gift and vidai counter for gutka sahib with rumala, Sikh history sets and children's book sets — the campus's natural graduation, wedding and guest-gifting purchase

Web-search budget for the session was exhausted after 10 searches, so two intended confirmations were not completed: (a) the exact current GST notification status of exercise books/notebooks and basic student stationery after the Sept-2025 rationalisation (printed books under HSN 4901 are long-standing nil-rated — that part is solid), and (b) a dedicated source on monsoon/mildew book-storage practice for hill retail. The hill-damp storage cautions in the notes are operational judgement, not cited fact.
